rule: These directives encode the latest explicit user instruction and supersede older PR descriptions, comments, tests, scheduler summaries and inferred policy whenever they conflict. Autonomous research, remediation, promotion and integration workflows may enforce but may not redefine this file.

paper_v7_authorization.interpretation: These are PAPER hard ceilings/floors and authorized sleeve allocations, not targets to force trading. Executable depth, authoritative fees, slippage, queue/fill state, adverse markout, uncertainty/capital-time economics, state integrity and the 15% drawdown kill switch still bind.

architecture.target: one unified V7 PAPER engine on main

legacy_retirement.before_gate: V3/V4/V5/V6 are compatibility-only. Do not create new legacy production architecture; migrate useful contracts, evidence and runtime primitives into V7/common code.
legacy_retirement.after_gate: Stop legacy research/runtime schedulers and remove superseded V3/V4/V5/V6 entrypoints, configs, adapters, tests, workflows, dashboards and obsolete research branches. Rename any remaining v6_* dependency required by V7 into canonical V7/common primitives before deleting its legacy source.

model_contracts.pca: single-leg residual statistical arbitrage only; evaluate 30m, 1h, 2h and 6h separately; no mandatory hedge basket, terminal-probability semantics or binary Kelly
model_contracts.local_factor: leave-targets-out orientation-invariant factor basis, null-preserving inference, dependence-robust multiplicity, fresh completed regular history at decision time, phi^h forecast and PnL-unit hedge ratios; evaluate 30m and 60m separately
model_contracts.cross_sectional_ranking: relative top-vs-bottom executable ranking; evaluate 30m, 1h, 2h and 6h separately; do not pool inference across horizons
model_contracts.micro_maker: optimize fill-conditioned net PnL, not fill probability; queue, OFI, imbalance, microprice, depth, toxicity and adverse markout are required; exits/markouts are quantity-specific depth-aware
model_contracts.micro_taker: complete executable round-trip target with entry ask VWAP, expected/realized exit bid VWAP, both authoritative fees, slippage, uncertainty, adverse markout and capital-time costs
model_contracts.graph_rv: prospective dual-clock joint-state evidence only; no product/minimum of marginal fill probabilities; explicit partial-state unwind; fixed-horizon executable liquidation for full and partial states; dependence-robust chronological inference
model_contracts.hard_arb: strict receive/exchange freshness, executable depth, authoritative fees, sequential-leg latency and explicit partial-fill unwind accounting
model_contracts.external_intelligence: fail closed; raw external features never become a synthetic terminal probability without approved probability mapping and evidence

rules: keep state, PnL, labels and inference separate by frequency
do not select a new frequency post hoc on the same holdout
new frequencies require prospective chronological evidence

current_priority_order: Keep every V7 policy surface aligned with the current bounded PAPER authorization: <=1000 markets, >=$2 liquidity, >=0.5 bp post-cost edge, uncertainty penalty >=0, Kelly <=25%, max $125/trade, market/event/gross <=5%/15%/70%, sleeves 22/12/34/22/8/2, drawdown <=15%, PAPER-only and authenticated execution disabled.
Make the unified V7 exact head deterministic-green: Local Factor orientation-invariant PC1, maker bounded-delay depth-aware contracts, scheduler registry and all V7 runtime/policy tests.
Validate and integrate Graph/RV v3 executable dependence-robust joint-state admission and runtime process-group draining/single-writer ownership into V7/common primitives.

Repair Local Factor temporal freshness so stale fitted residual states can never be combined with a current executable book; preserve pair-specific controls, PC1, conditional null bootstrap, IUT and BY.

Continue multi-frequency PCA, Local Factor, cross-sectional ranking, Micro Maker, Micro Taker, Graph/RV, hard arb and External Intelligence evidence with separate chronological state and PnL by horizon/frequency.
Run the exact-green unified V7 candidate continuously in isolated PAPER evidence mode without mutating the incumbent champion until integration gates are satisfied.
Create one fresh V7 integration from current main with exact source SHA/provenance; merge only after deterministic, governance, executable-economic and data-health gates are satisfied.
Run exact-SHA CI, monitoring, live-paper, private single-writer and server-health validation; advance paper-validated and deploy the identical V7 SHA for continuous PAPER operation.

After the V7 retirement gate is satisfied, stop compatibility schedulers and delete all superseded V3/V4/V5/V6 code, adapters, workflows, tests, configs, dashboards and obsolete branches, leaving one canonical V7/common system.

scheduler_assignments.administrator-supervisor: Treat convergence to one V7 system and post-health legacy retirement as project-level invariants. Report any scheduler or PR that recreates legacy production architecture, weakens the bounded PAPER envelope, duplicates runtime ownership or delays eligible legacy retirement.
scheduler_assignments.research-policy: Treat this file as current operator authorization. Enforce the bounded V7 PAPER envelope, one-ledger/one-owner architecture, exact provenance, PAPER-only/authenticated-disabled separation, and forbid cleanup before the V7 retirement gate or new legacy production architecture before it.
scheduler_assignments.research-queue: Prioritize V7 deterministic blockers, Local Factor freshness, Graph/runtime execution evidence, multi-frequency V7 model evidence and external intelligence. Before the retirement gate, legacy work is migration-only; after the gate, stop launching V6 research and route work to canonical legacy retirement until clean.
scheduler_assignments.promotion-controller: Promote only exact-source V7 integrations with green technical/governance gates and executable OOS economics where applicable. The bounded PAPER envelope, single writer/broker/ledger and same-SHA validation are hard requirements.
scheduler_assignments.integration-merge: Merge only the single canonical V7 integration from current main after exact-head revalidation. Refuse duplicate runtime owners, stale policy surfaces, legacy expansion and cleanup-before-health candidates.
scheduler_assignments.control-plane-event-bridge: Dispatch only the existing Promotion Controller after validator completion and Integration Merge after successful controller completion. Never merge, deploy, mutate paper-validated, reinterpret policy or execute orders directly.
scheduler_assignments.post-merge-validation: Bind code, monitoring and live-paper validation to the exact merged V7 SHA and trigger the normal same-SHA path toward paper-validated/deploy; do not declare legacy retirement eligible before all gate components are green.
scheduler_assignments.code-validation: Enforce bounded V7 policy, deterministic model contracts, single-owner runtime contracts, scheduler completeness and the legacy-retirement ordering contract in Release and Debug.
scheduler_assignments.monitoring-validation: Validate V7 per-strategy/per-frequency PnL, fills, markouts, queue/depth, process ownership, exact deployed revision and whether the legacy-retirement gate is or is not satisfied.
scheduler_assignments.live-paper-validation: Validate the exact unified V7 candidate on public data without weakening executable economics merely to force trades; advance paper-validated only on exact-SHA success.
scheduler_assignments.paper-server-deploy: Deploy only the exact paper-validated V7 revision; verify the deployed SHA and preserve PAPER-only/authenticated-disabled separation.
scheduler_assignments.paper-server-health: Verify same deployed V7 SHA, single writer/process ownership, recorder, broker, proxy, Grafana/metrics, risk and data freshness. A green result is required before legacy retirement begins.
scheduler_assignments.forward-maker-research: Accumulate prospective V7 maker evidence across HF cadences using fill-conditioned PnL, causal queue/flow state and bounded-delay quantity-specific depth-aware markouts; do not optimize fill count alone.
scheduler_assignments.v6-live-data-research: Compatibility/migration evidence only until the V7 retirement gate. Do not create new V6 architecture or promotion paths. After the gate, this scheduler must be retired rather than extended.
scheduler_assignments.alpha-factory: Rank V7 challengers by executable OOS economics and incremental utility, using chronology-safe independent evidence. Do not propose legacy expansion or weakening the bounded PAPER envelope as alpha work.
scheduler_assignments.meta-supervisor: Drive the current priority order toward one V7 system. Before the retirement gate coordinate migration and validation; after the gate switch the control plane to legacy-retirement mode and keep dispatching cleanup until superseded V3/V4/V5/V6 surfaces are gone.
scheduler_assignments.fast-arb-shadow-research: Collect read-only V7 hard/fast-arbitrage evidence across HF cadences with strict receive/exchange freshness, depth, verified fees, legging latency and unwind accounting.
scheduler_assignments.arb-theory-research: Derive Graph/structural V7 candidates under prospective joint-state fixed-horizon execution economics, never marginal-fill products or assumed terminal payout floors.
scheduler_assignments.external-intelligence: Collect, persist and chronologically validate public external information for V7; publish research evidence only and keep probability mapping fail-closed.
scheduler_assignments.live-api-smoke: Read-only Gamma/CLOB connectivity and freshness only; no policy/state mutation.
scheduler_assignments.v7-cross-sectional-ranking-research: Run scheduled relative cross-sectional ranking research with frozen point-in-time data, chronological holdouts and separate horizon inference; publish research-only evidence and never mutate champion, paper-validated, deployment, capital or authenticated execution.
scheduler_assignments.v7-point-in-time-universe-archive: Archive the exact paper-validated public universe every 30 minutes into immutable point-in-time snapshots for causal V7 PCA, Local Factor and ranking research; remain read-only with respect to champion, execution, PnL and risk state.
scheduler_assignments.v7-unified-paper-evidence: Continuously reconcile only an exact-green unified V7 research head into an isolated per-SHA PAPER runtime and collect machine-readable execution evidence without changing the incumbent champion, paper-validated, deployment or authenticated execution.
scheduler_assignments.v6-market-cache-relay: Compatibility data relay only until the V7 retirement gate. Do not mutate V7 policy/champion or create new V6 state. After the gate, migrate any still-required cache primitive to V7/common naming and retire this scheduler.

forbidden_regressions: Do not restore the superseded unbounded/no-fixed-cap V7 policy or exceed the current $125 and 5%/15%/70% PAPER ceilings while claiming operator authorization.
Do not restore the older 2.5%/8%/45% envelope as an immutable V7 requirement; stricter runtime choices are allowed, but the current authorization is the bounded envelope above.
Do not delete legacy code before the unified V7 SHA is merged to main, exact-SHA validated, advanced to paper-validated, deployed as the same SHA and server-health green.
Do not keep V3/V4/V5/V6 production architecture or compatibility schedulers after the legacy-retirement gate is satisfied; migrate required primitives and retire them.
Do not add authenticated or real-money execution.
Do not create a second live state writer, broker owner or execution ledger.
Do not write scheduler-generated code or artifacts outside this repository except existing registered private PAPER runtime/deployment/telemetry channels.
